caption: The drawing depicts two versions of the same object, a decorative drawstring bag or pouch. The main object is shown in full color on the left side, with a cream-colored body and a central panel featuring embroidered flowers in shades of pink, white, blue, yellow, and green. The floral embroidery is set against a tan background bordered with a thin black and white zigzag trim. The top of the bag is gathered with cream-colored ribbons, with additional ribbon details tied in bows at the sides. The lower portion of the bag, which is also cream-colored, has additional painted or embroidered floral motifs in green, pink, and yellow. Adjacent to this colored depiction, on the right side of the drawing, is a pencil sketch showing an alternate decorative design for the same shape of bag. This sketched version features a small human figure, possibly a girl in a dress holding a branch or object, surrounded by foliage and floral elements, all rendered in detailed line work without color. The background of the image is a plain, light tan or off-white paper.
title: Pocket Case or Reticule
